name: Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Copenhagen
title: Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Copenhagen
description: Location: Fælledparken, Copenhagen, Denmark Dates: June 12–14, 2026 Time: 9:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m. CEST (Park and citywide event hours vary by ticket) Trainers can look forward to exceptional coaching by Team Valor’s leader, Candela, during an exciting park session in Fælledparken that will help them become their very best. Ticket-holding Trainers will also set off on a citywide adventure across four distinct City Districts in Copenhagen, developing their skills and earning a unique in-game Pokémon GO Expert medal. All event gameplay is exclusive to ticket holders. You will only be able to experience the park experience within Fælledparken during the date and time noted on your event ticket. Citywide gameplay requires either a Base event ticket with citywide gameplay, a Citywide Gameplay add-on, or a City Explorer ticket.

name: Twitch Drops for 2026 Pokémon North American International Championships
title: Twitch Drops for 2026 Pokémon North American International Championships
description: Get codes for exclusive Timed Research and a Battle Bundle during the 2026 Pokémon North American International Championships Twitch broadcast. When P4T0M4N reached the top at the 2026 Pokémon GO Europe International Championships, he had his faithful Seaking helping him along the way. Watch the 2026 NAIC stream, and you can get one of your own to join your team. Tune in to Twitch.tv/PokemonGO during NAIC or the Grand Finals on Twitch.tv/Pokemon , and you’ll earn rewards the longer you watch. Here’s what you can get: Watch for 30 minutes: Unique Timed Research that includes the following. Watch for 45 minutes: An NAIC Battle Bundle that includes the following. Both redemptions must be claimed by June 26, 2026, at 8:00 p.m. PDT. Find more information on the Timed Research from the Twitch Drops in the Research section .
